news.desc.0: Gausin has expanded its environmental engineering offerings with a complete Waste Management product line including ETP/STP treatment plants, biomass solid waste systems, biogas & CNG plants, scrubber systems, and industrial incinerators designed for CPCB compliance and sustainable operations.
news.desc.1: Gausin is actively recruiting Draftsman, Process Engineer, Instrumentation Engineer, Site Manager, Sales Executive, Procurement Executive, Data Analyst, and Full Stack Web Developer with AI roles. Apply now and grow with us.
news.desc.2: Our portfolio now covers falling film, forced circulation, and plate-type evaporators alongside spray dryers, spin flash dryers, fluidized bed dryers, and ATFD systems for dairy, pharma, chemical, and food applications.
news.desc.3: Gausin delivers complete milk processing solutions including pasteurizers, chilling plants, CIP systems, butter & ghee lines, and storage silos - engineered for FSSAI compliance and continuous hygienic operation.
news.desc.4: Custom-designed effluent and sewage treatment plants with primary, secondary, and tertiary stages - meeting CPCB/SPCB discharge norms for textile, pharma, food, chemical, and municipal applications.
news.desc.5: Gausin offers turnkey EPC scope from process simulation and detailed engineering through in-house fabrication, site erection, commissioning, operator training, and after-sales support under one roof.
news.desc.6: Gausin equipment and plants serve leading organizations in pharmaceutical, dairy, food processing, chemical, sugar, and municipal sectors - including GSK, Chitale Dairy, Nectar Lifesciences, Jain Irrigation, and more.
news.desc.7: Turnkey biogas solutions with anaerobic digesters, gas purification, and CNG compression for dairy waste, distillery spent wash, food processing rejects, and municipal organic waste.
news.desc.8: With headquarters in Meerut, Uttar Pradesh, Gausin International Engineers supplies process equipment and turnkey plants across India - supporting clients in dairy cooperatives, pharmaceutical manufacturing, and industrial processing.
